params.name: workspaceType
params.description: Type of workspace to list files from

items.docs: Returns a filterable, paginated list of files and folders within a specific workspace type. The workspaceType path parameter selects between the public workspace (shared across all users) and the private workspace (user-specific). Used for workspace-scoped discovery and management operations.
